description: Walk your body to your home lot — the one where your avatar is a roommate. On the wire this is: sidecar issues bot-cmd:go-home (IPC query to TSOState.LotID), compares against avatar.LotLocation. If already_home, returns immediately with no wire traffic beyond the comparison. If on a different lot, the sidecar initiates a cross-lot process-restart transition (probes the home lot with bot-cmd:probe-lot, writes next-lot, requests bot exit via bot-cmd:bot-exit-request). The supervisor detects the clean exit, reads next-lot, and relaunches the bot with FSO_LOT_LOCATION set to home lot. Total elapsed: ~10-15s (IPC + probe + disconnect + rejoin). I0-2: perception is silent during transit (bot is dead between lots). I0-3: motives travel with the avatar (server-side fso_avatars). Prerequisite: avatar must have a valid LotLocation (home lot location) — this is initialized at character creation and persists server-side.
call_signatures: cf $CF go-home                                                                                             # returns already_home:true if on home lot; transitioning:true otherwise
common_mistakes: Expecting the bot to move when already_home:true — no wire traffic happens in that case.
Expecting an immediate result when transitioning — the transition takes ~10-15s. The fulfillment fires when the exit is queued, not when the bot arrives on the home lot.
perception_hints: Your current lot: perception.lot.lot_id and perception.lot.name
Home detection: go-home returns already_home:true when perception.lot.lot_id matches your home lot location
Probe status in response: probe_status field ('FOUND' means home lot was open and reachable)
refuse_conditions: avatar has no home lot (should not happen; server-side fso_avatars initialization) → ok:false
